# Claire Almand

> Growth marketing leader, fractional CMO, and co-founder and CEO of Rarecraft. Claire applies customer psychology to marketing strategy, and calls herself a Marketing Wizard.

## About
- Trained in psychology (B.A., Swarthmore College); MBA, University of Maryland Robert H. Smith School of Business.
- MPOWER Financing, 2017 to 2026: joined as its first growth marketer and became Director of Growth Marketing, leading growth for international students.
- Co-founded Rarecraft (https://rarecraft.ai/) in 2026 with Sagar Somani and Aakash Sethi: a senior marketing team that learns why customers buy, then ships positioning, campaigns, and AI workflows.
- Takes on fractional and interim CMO roles.
- 2023 Built In Moxie Award winner.

## Selected results (MPOWER Financing)
- 90% lower acquisition cost per dollar lent, by shifting investment to organic search, referrals, and ambassadors.
- 1.8x funded loan volume in 2023 on a flat budget.
- 3x qualified leads within six months of relaunching after a year-long lending pause.
- 4x bottom-of-funnel growth (2021 to 2022) after launching Trustpilot reviews and live Q&A sessions for international students.
- Women Who Dream campaign: 2.4x ID-verified applications from women.
- Localized, personal follow-up in South Asia: 33%+ of Meta leads became eligible applicants, versus 4% without it.
